title: Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization (G.17, October 2026 data) — 9:15 a.m. ET, 45 minutes ahead of the business-inventories print
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/feeds/g17.html fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 613,804 bytes), the Board's own scheduling notice, verbatim: "In 2026, the G.17 release on Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization will be published at 9:15 a.m. on January 16, February 18, March 16, April 16, May 15, June 15, July 17, August 18, September 18, October 16, November 17, and December 16." Corroborated by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet, whose 2026-11-17 row reads "Retail sales + inventories, Import and export prices, Industrial production". Filed estimate rather than FED-confirmed per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep — the source is a Federal Reserve primary and the id's own initial research should promote it on that page. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the mtis-2026-11-17 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). The reason it is proposed rather than merely noted: an industrial-production co-release is the single classifier that separates a loud business-inventories nowcast vintage from a quiet one, measured this session on the Atlanta Fed's ContribArchives (1,822 same-quarter deltas, 79 of them MTIS vintages) — MTIS vintages naming industrial production move the change-in-inventory-investment contribution a median 0.0927pp with only 54.5% under 0.10pp, against 0.0234pp and 91.4% without, permutation p=0.00015. The calendar was tracking two of the three named releases in the 2026-11-17 GDPNow vintage (retail-sales-2026-11-17, import-export-prices-2026-11-17) and missing the one that carries the measured signal. Read the trap on this date the same way the proposing event's own does: three distinct releases share 2026-11-17 at three different hours — G.17 at 09:15 (October data), Advance Monthly Retail Trade at 08:30 (October data), MTIS at 10:00 (September data). Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measured grounds: no macro-keyed house playbook (grep re-run 2026-09-06, 0 hits), no instrument attaches. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
